communication_goal: 按可独立验证的步骤拆分任务。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure teammates stand at a whiteboard. On the RIGHT side of the whiteboard are THREE separate blank square sticky notes arranged horizontally, each with a small folded corner. One coworker gestures toward the notes without touching or hiding them, the other holds open palms. The entire rightmost sticky note is especially clear and unobstructed. No words, no arrows necessary, no extra props.
